subject: Urgent Request: Pen Test Report & Scope Clarification — Acme Health Review
messages:
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-12T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: Pen Test Report & Scope Clarification for Acme Health Review

Hi Marissa,

Following a heightened review after a vendor incident last week, our InfoSec team has asked us to obtain Redwood's most recent penetration test report (or a redacted summary) and a clear statement of the test scope. Specifically they need:
- Test dates and environment (production vs staging)
- Whether authenticated API/token workflows were tested and what credentials were used
- Network vs application testing coverage (external perimeter, internal services, cloud infra)
- A remediation status table for any findings labeled high/critical

Can you provide the report or a redacted version and a remediation tracker by EOD Friday? If you prefer, we can schedule a quick call with our security reviewer (Tom Rivera from SecureAudit will join).

This is time-sensitive for our procurement sign-off.

Thanks,
Sarah Jensen
Security Program Manager
Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-12T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Pen Test Report & Scope Clarification for Acme Health Review

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the specific asks. We absolutely understand the sensitivity and will prioritize. Quick notes:
- We ran a third-party penetration test in July 2025 (external black-box + authenticated API flows).
- The report contains technical findings that we normally redact for public distribution; we can provide a redacted executive summary plus a remediation tracker.
- Test environment: primarily production-equivalent (no real customer PII was accessed; testers used dedicated test tenants and service accounts).

I’m looping in Dev (platform/security lead) and Karthik (engineering) to prepare the redacted summary and remediation tracker. We will aim to deliver the redacted PDF and an XLS tracker by EOD Thursday (2025-08-14). If your team needs the full report under an NDA, we can arrange that with SecureAudit.

Would you like us to include the kernel-level/OS patch dates and whether fixes were backported to Dedicated instances?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-12T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pen test artifacts for Acme — attaching redacted deliverables

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: SecureAudit (deliverables) <deliverables@secureaudit.com>
Date: 2025-07-22T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood Inference — Penetration Test Report (final)
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Please find the final pen test deliverables attached. Per our contract we provide the full technical report to the customer contact with an NDA; we also provide a redacted executive summary and a remediation tracker for general distribution.

Attachment stubs: redwood_pen_test_full_2025-07.pdf (restricted), redwood_pen_test_summary_2025-07-redacted.pdf (for customer), remediation_tracker_template.xlsx

Summary notes from SecureAudit:
- Scope: External black-box assessment against public endpoints + authenticated API abuse testing using test service accounts. No internal-only host scans without explicit approval.
- Test window: 2025-07-10 to 2025-07-12.
- Findings: 3 high/critical (one privilege escalation on a staging helper service — remediated 2025-07-20), 7 medium, remainder low.
- Credentials used: short-lived test tokens and an isolated test tenant; no live customer PII was accessed.
- Recommended follow-ups: token rotation policy, stricter CSP headers on the public console, and additional fuzzing on streaming endpoints.

Internal action items (Dev):
- Generate customer-facing redacted summary (attached).
- Produce remediation_tracker_Acme_2025-08-14.xlsx with current statuses (in progress/fixed/mitigated).

--
Dev
Platform Security Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acmehealth.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@secureaudit.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deliverable: Redacted Pen Test Summary + Remediation Tracker (Acme)

Hi Sarah / Tom — attaching the customer-facing artifacts we discussed: a redacted executive summary and a remediation tracker populated with current statuses. Key callouts up front:
- Test scope: external black-box + authenticated API workflows. Test tenants and short-lived tokens were used; no live customer data was accessed.
- Timeframe: 2025-07-10 — 2025-07-12.
- High/Critical items: 3 total. All high/critical items were remediated by 2025-07-20; remediation evidence is referenced in the tracker (config changes, CVE patches, and patch dates).
- Dedicated instances: all kernel and library fixes were backported to Dedicated pools on 2025-07-27 per our release notes.

Attachments (for your review):
- redwood_pen_test_summary_2025-07-redacted.pdf (redacted executive summary)
- remediation_tracker_Acme_2025-08-14.xlsx (status, owner, mitigation evidence)

Related artifacts: SOC 2 report (public summary): https://redwood.example.com/soc2/report-2024.pdf

If you need the unredacted report, we can arrange an NDA and a secure transfer hosted by SecureAudit. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call with Tom and your reviewers to walk through any technical questions.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@secureaudit.com>
Date: 2025-08-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deliverable: Redacted Pen Test Summary + Remediation Tracker (Acme)

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. A couple quick follow-ups from our reviewer:
1) Did the authenticated API tests include token replay and session fixation scenarios?
2) Can you confirm the fixes were applied to both Hosted and Dedicated customers, or only to the hosted fleet?

If you can confirm 1–2 in writing, we should be able to close our procurement review. If any of this requires deeper evidence, we will request the unredacted report under NDA and may ask for short call with Tom.

Appreciate the help —
Sarah
